initial.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2][blocker] Reconcile umbrella receipts with v3 source-evidence topology
initial.goal: Accept truthful v3 S-to-E-to-H child proof topology without weakening umbrella terminality or evidence checks.
initial.required_outcome: A valid terminal child and umbrella fixture with S not equal to E not equal to H passes while all product, evidence, ancestry, terminal, denominator, DAG, and native proof drift fails closed.
authority_boundary: Issue 96 exclusively owns the two declared tooling/test paths
No runtime, closeout, child product, terminal envelope, or publication mutation
operator_constraints: Work only in the issue-bound FastWork worktree
Preserve sixteen-child, exact-path, DAG, terminal, and #5878 native proof requirements
Use typed v2 lifecycle, exact review, and a ready green PR
initial.task_boundary: Repair only the WP-04 implementation-wave validator and its focused regression test.
deliverables: Exact PR head, merge, ancestry, and envelope validation
Focused positive and negative generated-history regression
Digest-bound execution proof and independent exact-head review
acceptance_criteria: Valid S not equal to E not equal to H topology passes
Protected product paths are unchanged across S through E through H
Evidence is introduced once at E and immutable through H
Exact PR head H, merge, ancestry, terminal envelope, and unique mapping are checked
Product drift, evidence drift, wrong head or merge or ancestry, ambiguous or missing mapping, and fake self-reference are rejected
Sixteen-child, path, DAG, terminality, and #5878 integrated/native bindings remain mandatory
Focused proof, independent review, and green CI pass
dependencies: Current C-SDLC v3 two-revision evidence model tracked by #53
non_goals: Weakening denominator, DAG, path, ancestry, evidence, or native receipt checks
initial.plan_summary: Bootstrap and bind issue 96, implement v3 topology reconciliation in the umbrella validator, prove generated Git histories, obtain exact-head review, and publish a green ready PR without merge.

steps.action: Bind exact tooling/test scope and inspect current v2/v3 proof topology.
Implement S-to-E-to-H validation while preserving all terminal and denominator gates.
Run focused generated-history positive and negative tests plus Ruby syntax checks.
Resolve independent exact-head review and publish one green ready PR.

invariants: Exactly sixteen WP-04 children and exact owned-path denominator
Dependency DAG and terminal merged envelopes remain mandatory
Product bytes unchanged after S and evidence bytes unchanged after E
#5878 integrated and native receipt bindings remain mandatory
risks: Treating ancestry alone as byte immutability
Fixture passing without exercising real Git object topology
stop_conditions: Owned scope must widen beyond the validator and focused test
Terminality or denominator checks would need weakening
Generated fixture cannot reproduce current v3 proof topology
Independent review has unresolved actionable findings

validation_lanes.proof_role: Generated Git histories prove valid S-to-E-to-H acceptance and all specified drift and terminality rejections.
Ruby parser accepts the validator and focused regression source.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on any product/evidence drift, wrong or ambiguous mapping, ancestry/head/merge mismatch, terminality weakness, denominator/DAG drift, native-proof omission, failed test, or unresolved review.
review_prompts: Can any post-S product mutation evade the validator?
Can evidence be replaced or modified after E?
Are H, merge ancestry, terminal envelopes, and mappings exact and unambiguous?
Are all sixteen children, paths, DAG edges, and #5878 native receipts still mandatory?
Does any self-referential fake evidence pass?
initial.review_scope: Issue 96 validator/test delta, generated Git topology fixtures, preserved terminality and denominator semantics.
